Kill a group of [[Charged Blackness]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill a group of Charged Blackness in [[the Underworld]].
* *BONUS* Kill a group of Charged Blackness in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
When you enter the Underworld, you'll arrive at the yellow spot on the map. Finish the first part of [[Clear the Chamber]] to open the doors, then proceed south towards [[Twin Serpent Mountains]]. Until then, you will mostly encounter [[warrior]] foes.

Move up the mountains, keeping your distance from  the [[Obsidian Behemoth]]s and their [[trap]]s. Several groups of Charged Blacknesses patrol here. To finish this quest, one of their groups needs to be killed.
